Title: Infrastructure as Code
Description: Provision all Azure infrastructure using Terraform with remote state in Azure Blob Storage. Covers networking, AKS, ACR, databases, Key Vault, and Application Gateway.

Title: Microservices Development
Description: Build 8 minimal microservices (frontend, api-gateway, user, product, cart, order, payment, notification) with Docker support and health endpoints.

Title: CI/CD Pipelines
Description: Implement fully automated YAML-based Azure Pipelines for every service with multi-stage deployment across dev, staging, and prod environments.

Title: Kubernetes Deployment
Description: Deploy all microservices to AKS using Helm charts with production-grade configurations: HPA, PDB, Network Policies, Workload Identity, and Key Vault CSI.

Title: Monitoring & Security
Description: Full observability via Azure Monitor, App Insights, Managed Grafana, and Defender for Cloud. Includes shift-left security via SonarCloud and Trivy.

Title: Terraform Remote State Backend
Description: Create Azure Storage Account and Blob container for Terraform state. Configure backend.tf with azurerm backend.

Title: Networking Module (VNet + Subnets + NSGs)
Description: Terraform module for VNet (10.0.0.0/8) with subnets for AKS / DB / AppGW / Bastion and NSG rules.

Title: Azure Container Registry (ACR) Module
Description: Terraform module for ACR Premium with vulnerability scanning and AcrPull role for AKS.

Title: AKS Cluster Module
Description: Terraform module for AKS with system/user node pools + Azure CNI + RBAC + Managed Identity + addons.

Title: Databases Module
Description: Terraform module for Azure SQL + Cosmos DB + Redis with private endpoints and encryption.

Title: Key Vault Module
Description: Terraform module for Key Vault with RBAC + soft delete + purge protection + secret storage.

Title: Application Gateway + WAF Module
Description: Terraform module for AppGW WAF v2 with SSL termination and OWASP 3.2 rules.

Title: Monitoring Infrastructure Module
Description: Terraform module for Log Analytics Workspace + App Insights (per service) + Managed Grafana.

Title: Environment Separation (dev/staging/prod)
Description: Separate tfvars and state files per environment. Resource tagging for all Azure resources.

Title: User Service (Node.js + Azure SQL)
Description: REST API: register / login / get-profile. JWT auth. Azure SQL connectivity. Multi-stage Dockerfile.

Title: Product Service (Python/FastAPI + Cosmos DB)
Description: REST API: list/get/create products. Cosmos DB SQL API. Multi-stage Dockerfile.

Title: Cart Service (Node.js + Redis)
Description: REST API: get/add/remove/clear cart. Redis Cache storage. Multi-stage Dockerfile.

Title: Order Service (Node.js + Azure SQL + Service Bus)
Description: REST API: place/get/update orders. Azure SQL + Service Bus event publishing. Dockerfile.

Title: Payment Service (Node.js — Mock)
Description: Mock payment REST API. Service Bus subscription. Always returns success. Dockerfile.

Title: Notification Service (Node.js + Service Bus)
Description: Subscribe to order/payment events. Mock email/SMS via console log. Dockerfile.

Title: Frontend (Next.js)
Description: Pages: home / product / cart / login / orders. Connects to API Gateway. Multi-stage Dockerfile.

Title: API Gateway (NGINX)
Description: NGINX routing to all services. Rate limiting. Request logging. Dockerfile.

Title: Reusable Pipeline Templates
Description: build-template.yaml + deploy-template.yaml + test-template.yaml in pipelines/templates/.

Title: CI Pipelines (8 services)
Description: Per-service CI: build + test + SonarCloud + Docker build + Trivy scan + push to ACR.

Title: CD Pipelines (dev / staging / prod)
Description: Multi-stage CD: deploy-dev.yaml + deploy-staging.yaml + deploy-prod.yaml with Helm.

Title: Terraform Validate & Apply Pipelines
Description: terraform-validate.yaml (on PR) + terraform-apply.yaml (on merge to main) with gates.

Title: Variable Groups & Environments Setup
Description: vg-common / vg-dev / vg-staging / vg-prod linked to Key Vault. Environments with approvals.

Title: Pipeline Security Hardening
Description: No hardcoded secrets. Pipeline run authorization. Retention policies. Audit logging.

Title: AKS Initial Setup
Description: Connect kubectl. Create namespaces (dev/staging/prod/monitoring). Install NGINX Ingress.

Title: Key Vault CSI Driver Setup
Description: Install Secrets Store CSI Driver. Create SecretProviderClass per service. Verify secret mount.

Title: Helm Charts (8 services)
Description: Helm chart per service: Deployment + Service + HPA + PDB + ServiceAccount + NetworkPolicy.

Title: Kubernetes Resource Configuration
Description: Resource requests/limits + liveness/readiness/startup probes + pod anti-affinity for all pods.

Title: Ingress & TLS Configuration
Description: Ingress resources per namespace with routing rules + Azure-managed TLS + rate limiting.

Title: Network Policies
Description: Default-deny ingress/egress. Allow only required service-to-service and Azure service traffic.

Title: Workload Identity (Managed Identity per pod)
Description: OIDC Issuer + Workload Identity on AKS. User-assigned managed identity per service federated with K8s ServiceAccount.

Title: Application Insights Integration
Description: Add App Insights SDK to all services. Distributed tracing + dependency + exception tracking.

Title: Azure Monitor & Container Insights
Description: Enable Container Insights on AKS. Diagnostic settings for all Azure resources to Log Analytics.

Title: Log Analytics KQL Queries
Description: Write and save KQL queries: slowest endpoints / error rate / failed logins / pod restarts.

Title: Grafana Dashboards
Description: Dashboards: AKS Cluster Overview + Application Health + Business Metrics.

Title: Alerts Configuration
Description: Alerts for CPU/memory/error rate/response time/pod restarts/SQL DTU. Action Group for email+Teams.

Title: Defender for Cloud Setup
Description: Enable Defender for Containers + SQL + Key Vault + Storage. Remediate Secure Score to >80%.

Title: Azure Policy & Governance
Description: Assign built-in policies. Custom policy for ACR. Policy Initiative. Assign to subscription.

Title: RBAC & Least Privilege
Description: Create AD groups (developers/devops/readonly). Review all role assignments. Enable PIM for prod.

Title: Pipeline Security (SAST + Trivy + Secrets)
Description: SonarCloud SAST + Trivy image scan + gitleaks secret scanning + npm audit + safety check in all CI pipelines.

Title: Network Security Hardening
Description: Verify NSG least-privilege. Enable DDoS Protection. Verify WAF Prevention mode. Private endpoints for all DBs.

Title: Secret Management Audit
Description: Zero secrets in code/pipelines/images/K8s manifests. All secrets in Key Vault. Access audit review.

Title: Create Azure free account and resource group rg-azureshop-dev
Description: Create Azure subscription. Create Resource Group rg-azureshop-dev in chosen region. Note Subscription ID.

Title: Enable all required Azure resource providers
Description: Enable: Microsoft.ContainerService, Microsoft.ContainerRegistry, Microsoft.KeyVault, Microsoft.Sql, Microsoft.DocumentDB, Microsoft.Cache, Microsoft.ServiceBus, Microsoft.Network, Microsoft.Storage.

Title: Create Azure DevOps org and project
Description: Create org azureshop-org at dev.azure.com. Create project AzureShop (Private). Enable all services.

Title: Initialize monorepo and configure branch strategy
Description: Create azureshop repo. Push initial structure. Create branches: main / dev / feature/* / release/* / hotfix/*.

Title: Configure branch policies on main and dev
Description: main: require PR + 1 reviewer + linked work item + block direct push. dev: require PR + build validation.

Title: Create Service Principal for Terraform
Description: Run az ad sp create-for-rbac for sp-azureshop-terraform with Contributor role. Store credentials in Key Vault.

Title: Create Service Connection in Azure DevOps
Description: Project Settings → Service Connections → New → Azure Resource Manager. Name: sc-azureshop-azure.

Title: Install and verify all local tools
Description: Verify: az / terraform / kubectl / helm / docker are installed and working. Login to az and set default subscription.
